title: A rational polynomial is asymptotic to its leading monomial
statement: Let $P\in\mathbf Q[x]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], let $a$ be its leading coefficient, and let $r=\deg P$ if $P\ne0$, with $r=0$ when $P=0$. Then $P(t)\sim a t^r$ as $t\in\mathbf Q$ tends to $+\infty$: explicitly, for every rational $\epsilon>0$ there is $T\in\mathbf Q$ such that $|P(t)-a t^r|\leq\epsilon |a t^r|$ for every rational $t\geq T$.
